summary: Takes a single State off a willing player by touch; the caster then suffers that State for 10 seconds. Not castable while Cursed.

effects.subject: target
effects.note: A single State only (the text does not cover Ongoing Effects). The text does not say who chooses the State.

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: Drawback: the caster gains the removed State with a new duration of 10 seconds. If that State is Insubstantial the caster may not remove themselves from it (L2).

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: Drawback: only when the transferred State is Insubstantial, the caster may not remove themselves from it.

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: Only when the State taken on is Insubstantial; the caster may not end it early (L2).

restrictions.note: Caster may not remove themselves from Insubstantial States gained through Martyr.

references.name: cursed
references.note: Caster may not cast Martyr while Cursed.

references.name: insubstantial
references.note: Caster may not exit an Insubstantial State gained through Martyr.

clarifications.text: The caster may not remove themselves from an Insubstantial State gained through Martyr (it lasts its 10 seconds).

open_questions: E1 does not say who chooses which State is removed when the target has several; presumably the caster.
